decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a surface variant of core drainage technology that the firm understands well, but as a trend-driven line only mentioned on the website it carries somewhat higher discontinuation risk.
The shower channel for seamless coverings builds directly on deep drainage expertise and the barrier-free strategy, and its dedicated page signals continued commitment.

Pump technology lies at the edge of the firm's knowledge base, and the 2024 launch of a related pump-drain channel could partly replace this line, but in-house R&D supports keeping it while the firm learns.
The tileable floor drain sits squarely within the established offer, so the firm can easily interpret its results and keep refining it.
A stainless steel design grate is a core metal-fabrication competence that fits the design-led positioning at low risk.
The pump-drain shower channel combines the firm's channel know-how with pump knowledge gained from Product C, which shows growing absorptive capacity, and it has a dedicated page.
